factsheet.heading: In Situ: Croydon Space Station
paragraphs: Croydon’s landmarks are transformed into spacecraft for an imagined future. Inspired by the borough’s space age architecture (Apollo House, Lunar House) and aviation heritage, this drop in workshop by architects and designers In Situ invites visitors to redesign familiar buildings as space crafts for life in orbit. Using specially designed templates and modelling materials, participants can contribute their creations to a shared map, transforming Croydon town centre into a space station.

factsheet.heading: Who are In Situ?
paragraphs: In Situ are an architecture and design studio with an emphasis on engaging with and celebrating youth culture. Working across traditional architecture — residential and community projects — alongside club night installations, festival builds and exhibition design, they draw on these varied projects to drive their processes of designing and making. Underpinning their practice philosophy is a commitment to providing young people with opportunities to access the architecture and design industries and have a voice within urban development.

factsheet.heading: Build / Play / Shape Croydon
paragraphs: This activity is part of Build / Play / Shape Croydon. Launch into a weekend of design-inspired creativity and play for all ages, 12-13 September. Find out more here: www.culturecroydon.com
